name: Countdown
description: Named countdown timers, driven from automations and displayed by the Countdown widget.

start.name: Start countdown
start.description: Start (or restart) a countdown for the given duration.

add.name: Add time
add.description: Extend the countdown. Use a negative value to take time away.

report-finished.name: Signal countdown end
report-finished.description: Fire the Countdown finished trigger. A displayed widget calls this on its own when the countdown reaches zero; use it to end one early.

finished.name: Countdown finished
finished.description: Fires when a countdown reaches zero. Requires the countdown to be displayed by a widget.
